name: UniTask 4.8.0
body:
## What's New
- Access the new interactive Markdown guide via the book icon in the notes top bar to preview syntax and Urdu text.
- Personalize your app with the new 'Plum' accent theme, available in both light and dark modes with high-contrast accessibility.

## Improvements
- Updated repository links and the update checker to ensure you stay connected to the new project home.
